dct_description_sm: This water quality data was collected by the Kivalliq Inuit Association (KIA) and Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada (CIRNAC)/Relations Couronne-Autochtones et Affaires du Nord Canada (RCAANC) through a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA), and by the KIA through their Inuu'tuti Monitoring Program. Data collected through these programs is used to document baseline conditions, determine natural variability, support the analysis of cumulative impacts, identify changes in water flowing through Inuit-owned lands in areas of the Kivalliq Region, and, along with the principles of Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit, to understand the impacts of climate change and increased human activity on Canada's arctic.
dct_title_s: Kivalliq Inuit Association and CIRNAC/RCAANC Joint Water Sampling and Inuu’tuti Monitoring Program
